summary_1line: Bhagiratha leads Ganga to his ancestors’ ashes; Jahnu briefly drinks the river; the sons of Sagara are liberated and Brahma blesses Bhagiratha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Jahnu, angered as the river floods his sacrifice, miraculously drinks the entire rushing Ganga in one draught.
The river Ganga bursts forth from Jahnu’s ear while gods and sages watch in astonishment.
The sacred Ganga flows over the ashes of Sagara’s sons as Bhagiratha stands grieving, and their spirits rise purified toward heaven.
